title: Live captions
privacy: Runs on this computer. Audio and captions never leave it. Downloading a model contacts its source, without sending audio.
choose: Use selected model for captions and Vibe
card: Uses the Partners graphics card choice above.
none: No model chosen. Download or select a verified model in Partners.
changed: The settings or model file is changed or unknown: {0}. It was left untouched. Close Vibe and review the file before choosing again.
running: Turn live captions off and close Vibe before changing the shared model.
failed: Live captions could not complete this step: {0}
route: Live captions requested {0}, but captiond is using {1}. Captions were stopped. Choose a working processor or graphics card in Partners.
slow: Live captions cannot keep up with speech on this processor or graphics card. Choose a smaller model or another graphics card in Partners.
waiting: Waiting for captiond to report the recognition device.
held: The connection is metered or could not be checked. The download waits. Choose Download anyway to continue.
missing: The selected model is not installed. No download was started.
busy: Another captiond or Kaption session is already running. Close it before starting live captions from Partners.
unavailable: The chosen graphics card could not be identified: {0}.
protocol: captiond did not provide a compatible status within 120 seconds.
quit: captiond or Kaption stopped unexpectedly. Live captions were stopped.
